health.disclaimer: These targets are general estimates for healthy adults, not medical advice. For your personal health needs, talk to a doctor or qualified professional.
health.title: Health Connect (optional)
health.intro: On Android you can let Rise120 read your steps and sleep from Health Connect, to see them here. It only reads. It never writes to Health Connect, and it stays off until you connect. You can disconnect at any time.
health.noTargets: Steps and sleep from Health Connect never change your calorie or nutrition targets.
health.unsupported: Health Connect is not available on this device or in this version of the app, so this stays off.
health.unavailable: Health Connect is not installed on this phone. Install it from the Play Store to use this.
health.updateRequired: Health Connect needs an update before Rise120 can use it. Update it from the Play Store.
health.getHealthConnect: Open Health Connect in the Play Store
health.denied: Access was not allowed, so nothing was connected. You can try again, or allow it in Health Connect settings.
health.error: We could not ask Health Connect for access. Please try again.
health.partial: Connected, but {{missing}} is not allowed, so it is not imported.
health.noDays: No steps or sleep found for the last 30 days.
health.manualKept: What you type in Rise120, such as your check-ins, is kept separately and is never changed by this.
health.syncFailed: We could not read Health Connect just now. What was imported before is kept. Please try again.
health.permissionLost: Access to Health Connect was taken away, so nothing new is imported. Allow it again in Health Connect settings, or disconnect.
health.disconnectAsk: Disconnect and remove the steps and sleep Rise120 copied from Health Connect? Your own check-ins stay.
health.disconnected: Disconnected. The copied steps and sleep were removed from Rise120.
health.restartNote: Health Connect access is being removed; on some Android versions that applies after the app restarts. You can also check it in Health Connect settings.
health.revokeManually: We could not remove access in Health Connect. Please remove Rise120 in Health Connect settings.

photo.open: Log a meal with a photo
photo.title: Log a meal from a photo
photo.intro: Take or choose a photo. We suggest foods from our sourced list for you to check. Nothing is logged until you choose a food, correct the amount and press Save. A photo cannot show the exact portion or everything in a dish, so treat it as a starting point.
photo.premiumOnly: Logging with a photo is part of Premium. You can still search for your food.
photo.accessUnknown: We could not check whether photo logging is available to you. Try again, or search for your food.
photo.permissionDenied: Camera access is off. You can allow it in your phone settings, choose a photo instead, or search for your food.

photo.unloggable: This item has no complete sourced nutrition, so it cannot be logged from a photo. Search for it instead.
photo.gone: That food is no longer available. Search for it instead.
photo.noMatch: We could not match your photo to a food in our sourced list. Search for your food instead.

photo.temporary: A short problem on our side stopped the check before it began. Your photo is kept; please try again.

buddy.intro: A private group of people you invite. Nobody else can find it.
buddy.disclosure: Members of a group can see your display name and the days you logged a workout. They cannot see your weight, photos, meals, check-ins or coach chats. You can leave at any time.
